segments.en: without dissension in your firm (20) belief. To each one in his own name. The Letter of the Seal is ended. writings including the Epistles 185; tr. GSR, 258. [R] {trace of one or more lines} ‘[...] not seen [...]. {do.1} And do not bear witness nor swear an oath time and time again, nor make others swear.’ {do.2} And in the Epistle to the (5) Presbyters ne says, ‘Do not speak in an irritated an confused manner, and let not a word of destruction go forth from your mouth, for it is from a word of destruction that a bloody demoness is born.’ (10) {do.3} And in the Epistle to Ḥatā he says, ‘Be obedient, and in the speech of your mouth [do not be] dissolute (?) but rather recite, by day and night, the L[aw], and praise [...] and lament for what the Redeemer suffered (?).’ (15) {do.4} And in the Gospel and in the [Treasure of the] Living he says, ‘On earth and in heaven and …’ [V] {lines missing and trace of one line} [...] and with patience (?) [...] {do.5} and loving [...] soothe one [another] and build each other up (again), (5) and (dispel) each other’s sorrows, and be dear to one another in kindness and always r[un] (?) with these secrets and edify each other. And [...] be of my appearance and nature, [and one will be] and (10) one will not. Perhaps you may do that [...] body [... {do.6} it is] not fitting [...] brethren [...] all of your helpers. And to the worthy [...] but to the best of my ability and [...] I shall be a helper to all of you.
